scope: Offline exact production selector and runtime _vet replays with endpoint occlusion veto and independent twin validation; no new physical acceptance. The bounded replay excludes model inference/transport and does not certify native total8s.
evidence_limits: The union40 already includes the offending finger volume; the single captured camera does not observe the intersected pink side. Witness box geometry is forensic only, never used by the veto.
Endpoint depth check operates on discrete calibrated pixel rays behind observed non-target depth. No all-space, whole-trajectory, pixel-frustum or continuous-control claim.
Invalid/zero depth, robot masks, target masks and out-of-view locations make no new claim. Existing target-inclusive approach surface checks remain.
Physical candidates, memory, stochastic proposals and dynamic scene in a future run may differ.
planning_budget_note: PLAN_BUDGET_S is the existing 3.0 seconds. Any historical replay prose describing it as 2s was a label error, not a runtime change; actual replays imported the existing constant.
